summary: The current machine still has only one scored/publishable company, GEV. Its canonical evidence remains unusually complete and high-confidence, with strong operating momentum, backlog, liquidity and execution evidence, but premium valuation remains the principal modeled weakness. The open XTND capitalization/runway directive is not closed by current evidence and must remain quarantined from admission or opportunity assessment until exact post-close capitalization and normalized cash-flow runway are reconciled.
